summary: Botanic Gardens car park south of the pin, bush behind, no homes.
reasons: Pin is in steep bush; car park is real place
Large car park with bush edge

best_section.where: Bush-side edge of the large car park about 30 m south of the pin

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the north-west side; only garden and non-residential buildings nearby.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed access road and marked bays; plenty of room to park fully off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy visitor car park by day; main road lies beyond the bush to the north.
drivers.convention: Mapped as free public parking; heavy day use, so a van blends in.

flags: Ring is in thick bush on a steep slope (max 33%), so the pin is off
Gardens may close or be patrolled at night
Arterial road noise from the north
Lift gate 238 m away, mapped way round
sun_shade: Open asphalt, palms and bush shading the north-west edge in the afternoon.
